backup.production_rule: Function bodies and one new read function only; no table, column or row is touched. (1) admin_stays_v1 keeps its signature, return columns, language, SECURITY DEFINER, search_path and grants (authenticated only) and its SQL body byte-for-byte (live md5 e2f41dcc6de28ba1ebe23b4534b6443d, CR stripped, read 2026-10-14); it is wrapped behind a one-row gate, new function admin_stays_gate_v1 (no API role can execute it), which raises 42501 not_authorized unless the session is owner/admin (manage_operations) or finance (read_finance, aal2), or has no JWT. Visible change: a cleaner, inspector or maintenance session is refused by admin_stays_v1 AND by the functions that read it (get_hospitality_metrics_v1, get_admin_overview_v1, get_guest_timeline_v1, run_health_checks_v1, get_report_drilldown_v1); none of the staff-app cleaner screens call them (only the Manage module, owner/admin). The Edge Functions do not call admin_stays_v1 (cascade-core/tools.ts reads the booking tables with the service key; service_role has never had EXECUTE). (2) New staff_calendar_history_v1(date, date, uuid default the property): owner/admin only, 400-day cap, source/id/dates/nights/status/first name only. The migration stops itself unless the live admin_stays_v1 still hashes to the md5 above. (3) staff_pay_admin_step_v1 (live md5 ee76bfac5542808058969b731940f343) gains one guard: 'cancel' on a paying request whose payer is not the caller returns not_yours (was: cancelled it). Same signature, return type, security mode and grants; a row Telegram started (no app payer) is also not_yours from the app. The migration also stops unless this body still hashes to that md5. (4) calendar_events: authenticated loses table-level SELECT and keeps column SELECT on every column except guest_phone, raw_summary and raw_description (guest_name stays: the checklist stay picker shows it). The two owner/admin readers that need those columns (admin-dashboard fetchStays / fetchStayDetail) move to the new admin_calendar_events_v1(property) and admin_calendar_event_v1(id) RPCs (manage_operations, SECURITY DEFINER). APPLY THE DATABASE BEFORE the dashboard switch only if the dashboard probes the RPCs and falls back; an OLD dashboard (select raw_summary / select *) gets 42501 on the calendar and stay-detail reads from the moment this applies, so deploy the switched dashboard first (it falls back to the direct select while the RPC is absent). Four SECURITY INVOKER functions name the hidden columns (check_availability, stay_same_guest_v1, stay_continues_v1, stay_chains_v1, get_missed_cleanings) and are called only by service-role Edge Functions and definer functions, so they keep working. The migration also stops unless the live calendar_events columns are the 25 it was cut from.

forward_verification.name: gate_exists_and_no_api_role_can_execute_it
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 and not bool_or(has_function_privilege('authenticated', p.oid, 'execute') or has_function_privilege('anon', p.oid, 'execute') or has_function_privilege('service_role', p.oid, 'execute')) from pg_proc p where p.oid = 'public.admin_stays_gate_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: admin_stays_v1_calls_the_gate_and_is_still_a_definer_with_an_empty_search_path
forward_verification.query: select prosrc ~ 'admin_stays_gate_v1' and prosecdef and proconfig @> array['search_path=""'] from pg_proc where oid = 'public.admin_stays_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure
